title: The Lost Patrol
text: A patrol from your own city staggers out of the fog, half starved after months lost beyond the Gate. Their boots are wrapped in rags. They thought you were ghosts. Their sergeant, grey and shaking, salutes the nearest House as if he has found a king.

options.label: Share your supplies and send them home, though it leaves you thin.

outcomes.text: Your own kit wears thin for it, but they make it home. The city hears who brought them.

options.label: The poorest House asks them to serve, offering them a home.

outcomes.text: One of them stays on, glad of any House that will have him.

options.label: Strip their gear; they are as good as dead anyway.

outcomes.text: They watch you take their good city iron. Word of it will reach home before they do, if they ever do.
